t: Robust Forge Steel 600mm (23.6") magnetic spirit level designed for precise levelling across various trade applications. Constructed from durable aluminium alloy with a box section frame, the professional spirit level offers longevity and resilience on site. Designed with an integrated magnetic base to ensure stable positioning on metal surfaces, making it ideal for tasks such as installing steelwork, metal studding, or pipework. Features 3 vials for 45°, 90° horizontal, and 180° vertical measurements, as well as reverse accuracy and a 1mm measuring accuracy, to deliver reliable results for all levelling requirements.
